INPUT FILES.disposition: Only authored private fixture bytes/types/links/metadata and independently decoded ustar members are checked. Other applicable file forms and effects remain open; sections specifying None impose no file-format witness.

ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES.disposition: C locale and UTC0 are pinned; find/deep-utf8 adds an installed UTF-8 locale. Other applicable locale, catalog and utility-specific environment behavior remains open; XSI-only NLSPATH is outside the selected base profile.

ASYNCHRONOUS EVENTS.disposition: Unqualified: watchdog cleanup is a harness guarantee, not an assertion of the utility signal contract. Requires controlled delivery during active operations.

STDOUT.disposition: Case byte expectations are exact except df spacing/live fields, du independently measured blocks, and file classification wording, whose normative predicates are explicit. Other formats and output errors remain open.

STDERR.disposition: Successful cases require empty stderr except dd authored record counts plus a vendor transfer-statistic line. Error wording uses a nonempty predicate; PTY rm uses exact selected-vendor prompts. Other diagnostic/localized conditions remain open.

OUTPUT FILES.disposition: Only authored private fixture bytes/types/links/metadata and independently decoded ustar members are checked. Other applicable file forms and effects remain open; sections specifying None impose no file-format witness.

EXTENDED DESCRIPTION.disposition: -a/-m isolation, -d date/time/zone forms, symlink handling, current-time tolerances, permission errors, unsupported timestamps and operand continuation remain unqualified.

EXIT STATUS.disposition: Every case checks zero or the normative positive-error class; signal death cannot satisfy a positive-error assertion. Other conditions remain open.

CONSEQUENCES OF ERRORS.disposition: Selected missing inputs, existing targets and dd RLIMIT_FSIZE are strict assertions. Real quota/ENOSPC/EIO, continuation and signal recovery require disposable fault environments and remain open.
